messages:
sarah: Quick final pass — we need to lock the onramp landing variants for Hosted / Dedicated / Private before the webinar campaign tomorrow. Draft below and asks:

sarah: 1) choose hero line per mode 2) confirm CTA/registration copy 3) confirm lead routing tags

matt: Love it. For Hosted hero: "Start building with instant API access — predictable pricing, low latency." CTA: "Try Hosted API" — sends tag hosted_trial. :white_check_mark:

anika: Suggest tightening Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools. Predictable throughput, enterprise SLAs." CTA: "Request Dedicated" -> tag: dedicated_sales_lead

leo: Private: "Bring Redwood behind your VPC — compliant, auditable, and offline options." CTA: "Contact Private" -> tag: private_enterprise

anika: Routing snippet (for forms/webhook):

anika: ```json
{"mode": "hosted", "cta": "Try Hosted API", "lead_tag": "hosted_trial"}
{"mode": "dedicated", "cta": "Request Dedicated", "lead_tag": "dedicated_sales_lead"}
{"mode": "private", "cta": "Contact Private", "lead_tag": "private_enterprise"}
```

matt: Webinar post blurbs (short + benchmark hook):

matt: Twitter: "See how teams cut inference cost 3x with Redwood's batching + KV cache. Live demo + roadmap — Wed 11am PT. RSVP: [link]" 

matt: LinkedIn: "Realtime benchmarks + migration stories from Hosted→Dedicated customers. Panel + Q&A. Seats limited." 

sarah: Love the benchmark phrasing. Add one metric we can confidently claim? "3x cost reduction" ok to use? (we have internal evals)

anika: Use "up to 3x" to be safe. Also: ensure the landing has a short bullets section: "what we'll show" — Latency SLOs, batching gains, cost/mm tokens.

leo: Subject lines for webinar invite:

leo: - "How we cut LLM inference costs by up to 3x — Redwood live demo"

leo: - "Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private: pick the right inference path"

sarah: Action owners:

sarah: - @matt finalize social copy + short hero variants by EOD (owner)

sarah: - @anika wire the form routing + add hidden field lead_tag mapping (owner)

sarah: - @leo prep webinar slides for the benchmark section (owner)

deploy-bot: Scheduled post: marketing-webinar-announce -> 2024-05-10T18:00:00Z

sarah: If no objections I'll push the three hero CTAs into final HTML and hand to @web-team at 5pm. Any blockers?

matt: None from me. :thumbsup:

anika: All good — I'll validate webhook schema after forms are live.

leo: good to go.
